name: save-boot-8-world-midgar
description: #80, world map: boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-wm0-midgar.json: module state 3 (world map) with exit action 0, and location 1 (wm0, 'Outside Midgar' in ff7-flat-wiki Field_ID); party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; progress 6 (md1stin's value: no reachable source documents the progress value here). In the decomp (reference only) the title's load copies the state into g_GameState and the exit action into the world map's entry argument, so the world map should start at that entry point, as when a field exit leads there. Load as save-boot-1-load does, but wait for g_GameState 3 (w_state). Then 600 frames for the world map to load, a mark, 60 frames of Up and 30 still. Checks: g_GameState still reads 3 at the end (world_ok), g_FieldCurrentMap still names the entry point (map_ok), and a rerun from the title snapshot ends in the same state (match). Reported: wm_id (the world overlay's map number, 0 = the main world map), prev_state.

game_state.description: g_GameState (s16 as u16; field 1, battle 2, menu 5 confirmed #76).

map_cur.description: g_FieldCurrentMap (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): in the world map, the entry point the save names.

wm_id.description: World overlay D_800E5634 (WmGetWmId; s32, low half): which world map runs, 0 = the main map, 2 = underwater, 3 = snowfield. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c, config/symbols.world.txt. A hypothesis read only while the world overlay is loaded.
